headline: Eastman Chemical (NYSE:EMN) Beats Q2 Estimates but Cautious Guidance Dents Sentiment
summary: Eastman Chemical beat Q2 estimates with $1.97 EPS and $2.51B revenue, but shares fell on cautious Q3 guidance and lower cash flow forecast.
